Hi Jessica —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for this pilot. To get the implementation team lined up, we want to run a short "minute-zero" kickoff (30–45m) to align stakeholders, confirm access, and lock the first two weeks of work. Proposed agenda and asks below.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Option A: Thu Sep 9, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Option B: Fri Sep 10, 13:00–13:45 PT

Agenda (30–45m):
1) Introductions + roles (5m)
2) High-level scope & success criteria (10m)
3) Access checklist: SSO, data endpoints, test datasets (5m)
4) Implementation cadence & first two sprint milestones (10m)
5) Q&A + next steps / calendar binds (5–10m)

Please:
- Confirm which window works (A or B) or propose up to two alternatives with time zone.
- Share the attendee roster (names + titles + timezones).
- Flag any compliance or procurement blockers we should prep for in advance.

I attached a draft kickoff agenda and a one-page mutual action plan. Marcus (SE) and Naomi (CSM) are looped for hosting and technical readiness.

Attachments: kickoff_agenda_v1.docx (docx), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

Best,
